what: When visible, the text grows one character every 60ms like a typewriter, and each new character cycles through ~!@$%^&*()-+=[]{}<>? symbols mixed together, then each character resolves to its own letter from the front, 120ms per character (the mixed symbols are redrawn every 60ms). With order: random the resolve order is random, so they lock in here and there — section titles in order, the barcode text below them at random. Phone menu links each: 70

options.each: Per-character release share (ms), default 120 — original phone menu 70
options.step: Interval (ms) for growing by one cell and re-picking the symbol, default 60
options.order: With random, the release order is random (original barcode text)
options.on: view (default, once as soon as even one pixel is visible) · load (right after mounting, after the delay)
